Source: Same number of HBV mono-infected individuals were recruited into the study and subsequently, HBV serological profiles which includes HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAg, HBeAb, HBcAbIgM and HBcAbIgG were assayed using HBV ELISA kits.

Source: Nigerian researchers report that people with HIV and Hepatitis Virus B (HIV/HBV) have different levels of markers relating to HBV disease than patients with HBV only.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza mu ggwanga lya Nigeria bagamba nti bantu abalina HIV n’akawuka ka Hepatitis B (HIV/HBV) balina obubonero bwa njawulo obwekuusa ku bulwadde bwa HBV okusinga abalwadde abalina HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ nínú àbọ̀ ìwádìí wọn pé àwọn èèyàn tó ní HIV àti àrùn Ẹpataidisi B (HIV/HBV) ní ipò àwọn aṣàfifàn tó ṣọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀, èyí tó jẹ mọ́ àrùn HBV ju ti àwọn aláìsàn tó ní HBV nìkan lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baseNayjeriya babika ukuthi abantu abane-HIV ne-Hepatitis Virus B (HIV/HBV) banamazinga ahlukene omaka ahlobene nesifo se-HBV kuneziguli ezine-HBV kuphela.
Hausa: Masu bincike a Nijeriya sun bayar da rahoton cewa mutanen da suke ɗauke da Ƙwayar cutar HIV da Ciwon Hanta na B (HIV/HBV) suna da matakan alamomi daban-daban da suka shafi cutar HBV fiye da masu ɗauke da Ciwon Hanta na B kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba Nigeria ba bega gore batho bao ba nago le HIV le Hephathaethisi ya Baerase B (HIV/HBV) ba na le dikelo tša go fapafapana tša maswao tše di amanago le bolwetši bja HBV go feta balwetši bao ba nago le HBV fela.
Amharic: የናይጄሪያ ተመራማሪዎች የኤችአይቪ እና የሄፐታይተስ ቫይረስ ቢ (ኤችአይቪ/ኤችቢቪ) ያለባቸው ሰዎች ኤችቢቪ ብቻ ካለባቸው ታማሚዎች የተለየ ደረጃ ያላቸው ከኤችቢቪ በሽታ ጋር የተያያዙ ጠቋሚዎች እንዳላቸው ዘግበዋል።

Source: This could mean that HIV patients have a higher chance of developing HBV complications.
Luganda: Kino kiyinza okutegeeza nti abalwadde ba HIV balina omukisa munene okufuna obuzibu bwa HBV.
Yoruba: Èyí lè túnmọ̀ sí pé àwọn aláìsàn HIV wà ní ipò tó ga láti máa ní àwọn ìnira tó jẹ mọ́ HBV.
Zulu: Lokhu kungasho ukuthi iziguli ezine-HIV zinethuba eliphezulu lokuthuthukisa izinkinga ze-HBV.
Hausa: Wannan na iya nufin cewa masu cutar HIV suna da babbar dama ta samun matsalolin HBV.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka šupa gore balwetši ba HIV ba na le sebaka sa godimo sa go swarwa ke malwetši a HBV.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች የኤችቢቪ መወሳሰቦችን የማዳበር እድላቸው ከፍ ያለ ሊሆን ይችላል።

Source: In this study, researchers showed the difference in HBV protein levels between people with HIV/HBV and those with HBV only.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baalaga enjawulo mu bungi bwa puloteyini ya HBV mu bantu abalina HIV ne HBV n’abo abalina HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àfihàn ìyàtọ̀ bí purotéènì ṣe pọ̀ tó láàárín àwọn tó ní HIV/HBV àti àwọn tó ní HBV nìkan.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bakhombise umehluko kumazinga e-HBV protein phakathi kwabantu abane-HIV/HBV nalabo abane-HBV kuphela.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun nuna bambanci a matakan furotin ɗin HBV a tsakanin mutanen da suke ɗauke da ƙwayar cutar HIV/HBV da wasanda suke da HBV kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba bontšhitše phapano go dikelo tša protheine tša HBV magareng ga batho bao ba nago le HIV/HBV le bao ba nago le HBV fela.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ኤችአይቪ/ኤችቢቪ ባለባቸው እና ኤችቢቪ ባለባቸው ሰዎች መካከል ያለውን የኤችቢቪ ፕሮቲን መጠን ልዩነት አሳይተዋል።

Source: This difference could impact the way their HBV infection is treated, as well as the progression of their HIV status.
Luganda: Enjawulo eno eyinza okukosa engeri obulwadde bwabwe obwa HBV gye bujjanjabwamu, awamu n’enseetuka yaabwe ku kawuka ka HIV.
Yoruba: Ìyàtọ̀ yíí lè ní ipa pẹ̀lú bí wọ́n ó ṣe ṣẹ ìwòsàn fún àrùn HBV, àti bí HIV wọn ṣe ń gbòòrò si.
Zulu: Lo mehluko ungaba nomthelela endleleni ukutheleleka kwabo kwe-HBV okuphathwa ngayo, kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kwesimo sabo se-HIV.
Hausa: Wannan bambance-bambance na iya yin tasiri a kan yadda ake bi da cutar HBV, da kuma ci gaban matsayinsu na HIV.
Northern Sotho: Phapano ye e ka ba le seabe go tsela yeo phetetšo ya bona ya HBV e alafšago, gammogo le go befela pele ga seemo sa bona sa HIV.
Amharic: ይህ ልዩነት የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን የሚታከምበት መንገድ ላይ እንዲሁም የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታቸው እድገት ላይ ተጽእኖ ሊያሳድር ይችላል።

Source: The researchers studied 250 patients in a Nigerian hospital and grouped them according to co-infection with HIV/HBV or only HBV, with an equal number of patients in each group.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beekaliriza abalwadde 250 mu ddwaliro ly’e Nigeria era ne bababinjawaza nga basinziira ku abo abalina HIV ne HBV oba abalina HBV yekka, nga buli kibinja kirimu abalwadde abenkana n’abali mu kirala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà lo àwọn aláìsàn 250 ní ilé-ìwòsàn kan ní Nigeria láti ṣe ìwádìí wọn, wọ́n pín wọn ní ọ̀wọ̀ọ̀wọ́ pèlú pé bóyá wọ́n ní HIV/HBV tàbí HBV nìkan, tí ìpin náà sì jẹ́ dọ́gbadọ́gba fún ọ̀wọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bahlole iziguli ze-250 esibhedlela saseNayjeriya futhi bazihlanganisa ngokuvumelana ne-HIV/HBV noma i-HBV kuphela, nenani elilinganayo leziguli eqenjini ngalinye.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazari a kan marasa lafiya guda 250 a wani asibiti a Nijeriya tare da rarraba su bisa ga kamuwa da cutar HIV/HBV ko HBV kaɗai, tare da adadin marasa lafiya a kowane rukuni.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile diphatišišo ka balwetši ba 250 go sepetlele sa Nigeria le go ba hlopha go ya ka go fetelwa ke malwetši ka bobedi a HIV/HBV goba bja HBV fela, ka palo ye e lekanago ya balwetši go sehlopha se sengwe le se sengwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በናይጄሪያ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ 250 ታካሚዎችን በማጥናት በኤችአይቪ/ኤችቢቪ የጋራ-ኢንፌክሽን መያዝን ወይም በኤችቢቪ ብቻ መያዝን መሰረት አድርገው በእኩል የታካሚዎች ቁጥር በቡድን በቡድን ከፍለዋቸው ነበር።

Source: Blood samples were taken from all the patients and the level of proteins specific to HBV were monitored.
Luganda: Sampolo z’omusaayi zaggyibwa ku balwadde bonna era obungi bwa puloteyini za HBV ne bulondoolwa.
Yoruba: Gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn ni wọ́n fi ẹ̀jẹ̀ sílẹ̀, àti pé wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ṣó ìpele purotéènì tó jẹ mọ́ HBV.
Zulu: Kwathathwa amasampula egazi kuzo zonke iziguli futhi kwaqashwa izinga lamaprotheni aqondene ne-HBV.
Hausa: An ɗauki samfuran jini daga duk marasa lafiyar kuma an kula da matakin furotin na musamman ga HBV.
Northern Sotho: Go kgobokeditšwe disampole tša madi go balwetši ka moka ebile go lekotšwe kelo ya diprotheine tše di amanago le HBV.
Amharic: ከሁሉም ታካሚዎች የደም ናሙናዎች ከተወሰዱ በኋላ ለኤችቢቪ ብቻ የተወሰኑ ፕሮቲኖች ደረጃ ላይ ክትትል ተደርጓል።

Source: The researchers found that co-infected patients were older with the majority being female, compared to those infected with HBV alone.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abalwadde abaalina obuwuka bwombi baali bakulu era ng’abasinga obungi baali bakyala, bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abaalina HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yí ri pé púpọ̀ nínú aláìsàn tó ní ìkárùnpò yìí jẹ́ àwọn àgbàlagbà, pàápàá jùlọ àwọn obìnrin, yàtò sí àwọn tó ní àrùn HBV nìkan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi iziguli ezitheleleke kanyekanye bezindala kanti iningi kungabesifazane, uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abangenwe yi-HBV kuphela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa majinyatan da suka kamu da cutar biyu manya ne kuma yawanci mata, idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda suka kamu da HBV kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore balwetši ba go fetelwa ke malwetši ka bobedi ba be ba na le mengwaga ya godimo moo bontši e bego e le basadi, ge go bapetšwa le bao ba fetetšwego ke HBV e le noši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኤችቢቪ ብቻ ከተያዙት ጋር ሲነፃፀሩ በጋራ ኢንፌክሽን የተያዙ ታካሚዎች በእድሜ የገፉ ሲሆኑ አብዛኞቹ ሴቶች መሆናቸውን ደርሰውበታል።

Source: They also noticed that blood samples of patients with both viruses had different levels of proteins specific to HBV.
Luganda: Baazuula era nti sampolo z’omusaayi gw’abalwadde abalina obuwuka bwombi zaalina obungi bwa puloteyini za HBV bwa njawulo.
Yoruba: Wọn tún ṣàkíyèsí pé ẹ̀jẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n gbà fuń àwọn tó́ ní àrùn méjéèjì ló ní ìpele purotéènì ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ tó jẹ mọ́ HBV.
Zulu: Baphinde babona ukuthi amasampula egazi eziguli ezinawo womabili amagciwane ayenamazinga ahlukene amaprotheni aqondene ne-HBV.
Hausa: Sun kuma lura cewa samfuran jini na marasa lafiya tare da ƙwayoyin cuta biyu suna da matakan furotin musamman ga HBV.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile le gore disampole tša madi tša balwetši bao ba nago le dibaerase ka bobedi di bile le dikelo tše di fapafapanego tša diprotheine tše di amanago le HBV.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ሁለቱም ቫይረስ ያለባቸው ታካሚዎች የደም ናሙናቸው መጠኑ የተለየ እና ለኤችቢቪ ብቻ የተወሰነ የፕሮቲን ዓይነት እንዳላቸው አስተውለዋል።

Source: Some of these proteins were higher and others were lower compared to patients with HBV only.
Luganda: Ezimu ku puloteyini zino zaali waggulu ate ng’endala ziri wansi bw’ogeraageranya n’abalwadde abalina HBV yekka.
Yoruba: Àwọn purotéènì míràn pọ̀, àwọn míràn sì kéré tí a bá ṣe ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú àwọn aláìsàn tó ní HBV nìkan.
Zulu: Amanye ala maprotheni ayephezulu kanti amanye ayephansi uma kuqhathaniswa neziguli ezine-HBV kuphela.
Hausa: Wasu daga cikin waɗannan furotin sun fi girma kuma wasu sun yi ƙasa sosai idan aka kwatanta da marasa lafiya da HBV kaɗai.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe tša diprotheine tše di be di le godimo mola tše dingwe di be di le fase ge go bapetšwa go balwetši ba HBV fela.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ፕሮቲኖች ውስጥ የተወሰኑት ከፍ ያሉ ሲሆኑ ሌሎች ደግሞ ኤችቢቪ ብቻ ካለባቸው ታካሚዎች ጋር ሲነፃፀሩ ዝቅተኛ ነበሩ።

Source: One specific HBV protein was only present in certain HIV/HBV patients.
Luganda: Waliwo puloteyini ya HBV emu eyasangibwa mu balwadde abamu abalina HIV ne HBV.
Yoruba: Purotéènì HBV kan pàtó wà ní ara àwọn aláìsàn tó ní HIV/HBV kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Iphrotheni eyodwa ethile ye-HBV yayikhona kuphela ezigulini ezithile ze-HIV/HBV.
Hausa: Ɗayan takamaiman furotin HBV ya kasance kawai a cikin wasu marasa lafiya na HIV/HBV.
Northern Sotho: Protheine ya HBV ya mohuta o itšego e be e hwetšagala fela go balwetši ba bangwe ba HIV/HBV.
Amharic: አንድ የተወሰነ የኤችቢቪ ፕሮቲን አይነት በተወሰኑ የኤችአይቪ/ኤችቢቪ ታማሚዎች ላይ ብቻ ነበር የሚገኘው።

Source: Higher HBV proteins usually meant patients would have a tendency to develop complications related to the disease.
Luganda: Puloteyini za HBV eza waggulu zaategeezanga nti abalwadde bajja kufuna obuzibu obwekuusa ku bulwadde.

Zulu: Amaprotheni e-HBV aphezulu ngokuvamile ayesho ukuthi iziguli zizoba nokuthambekela kokuthuthukisa izinkinga ezihlobene nesifo.
Hausa: Yawan furotin na HBV yawanci yana nufin marasa lafiya suna da yiwuwar haɗuwa da matsaloli masu alaƙa da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Diprotheine tša HBV tša godimo gantši di be di laetša gore balwetši ba tla itemogela mathata ao a amanago le bolwetši.
Amharic: ከፍ ያለ የኤችቢቪ ፕሮቲኖች መጠን መገኘት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ታማሚዎች ከበሽታው ጋር የተዛመዱ ችግሮችን የማዳበር ዝንባሌ እንዳላቸው ይጠቁማል ማለት ነው።

Source: The researchers used a small number of people for this study, which may not be enough to make conclusions about the wider Nigerian population.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakozesa omuwendo gw’abantu mutono mu kunoonyereza kuno, oguyinza okuba nga tegumala kukola kuwunzika ku bantu b’omu ggwanga lya Nigeria.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše palo ye nnyane ya batho ka dinyakišišong tše, bao ba ka bago ba se ba lekanela go fihlelela diphetho mabapi le badudi ba Nigeria ka bophara.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለዚህ ጥናት አነስተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸውን ሰዎች ተጠቅመዋል፤ ይህም ስለ ሰፊው የናይጄሪያ ህዝብ ለመደምደም በቂ ላይሆን ይችላል።

Northern Sotho: Gape go na le diprotheine tše dingwe tšeo di ka amago dipoelo tše tšeo banyakišiši ba sego ba di lebelela.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ያልተመለከቷቸው በእነዚህ ውጤቶች ላይ ተጽእኖ ሊያሳድሩ የሚችሉ ሌሎች ፕሮቲኖችም አሉ።

Source: Co-infection with HIV and HBV is common in sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Okubeera ne HIV ne HBV omulundi gumu kweyoleka nnyo mu Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu lya Sahara.

Hausa: Kamuwa da cuta tare da HIV da HBV ya zama ruwan dare a Afirka Kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Go fetelwa ke malwetši ka bobedi a HIV le HBV go tlwaelegile go dinaga tša borwa bja Afrika.

Source: HBV alone is responsible for around 800 000 deaths, and we know that HIV leads to a weakened immune system.

Yoruba: HBV nìkan ló ń ṣokùnfà ikú àwọn èèyàn bíi 800 000, àti pé a mọ̀ pé HIV maa ń ṣokùnfà àìlera inú àgọ̀ ara.

Northern Sotho: HBV e le noši e bakile mahu a 800 000, gomme re a tseba gore HIV e baka go fokola ga mašole a mmele.
Amharic: ኤችቢቪ ብቻ ለ800 000 ሰዎች ሞት ተጠያቂ ሲሆን ኤችአይቪ ደግሞ ደከም ወዳለ የበሽታ መቋቋም ስርዓት እንደሚመራ እናውቃለን።

Source: This study is a step towards developing better treatments for patients infected with both viruses.

Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše ke maitekelo a go tšweletša dikalafo tše kaone go balwetši bao ba fetetšwego ke dibaerase ka bobedi.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በሁለቱም ቫይረሶች ለተያዙ ታካሚዎች የተሻሉ ህክምናዎችን ለማዳበር አንድ እርምጃ ነው።

Source: The authors and patients of this study were based in Ile-Efe, Nigeria, where there is a high rate of HIV/HBV infections.

Northern Sotho: Bangwadi le balwetši ba dinyakišišo tše ba be ba etšwa Ile-Efe, Nigeria, moo go nago le kelo ya godimo ga diphetetšo tša HIV/HBV.
